description: This file defines the BasicDeviceAdminReceiver class, a subclass of DeviceAdminReceiver, that handles events related to a managed profile on Android devices, specifically the completion of profile provisioning and providing a component name for the receiver.

classes.name: BasicDeviceAdminReceiver
classes.description: A receiver class that handles device admin events, particularly profile provisioning completion, for a managed profile in Android.

methods.name: onProfileProvisioningComplete
methods.description: Handles the event when a managed profile has completed provisioning by starting the EnableProfileActivity.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns the ComponentName instance for this DeviceAdminReceiver, used throughout the app for device administration.
